svg.title: What a utility's file sets in a data center brief: the five documents and the capacity and dates they commit, and the outage record that sets generator duty, autonomy and fuel storage

g.text: FIGURE 03 / WHAT THE UTILITY FILE SETS
TWO CHAINS, BEFORE THE FIRST DRAWING
THE DOCUMENTS SET THE CAPACITY AND THE DATES
Phase 1 is drawn to the capacity committed in writing, by its date; later phases follow the later dates and the reinforcement.
THE OUTAGE RECORD SETS THE GENERATORS AND THE FUEL
Storage covers the longest credible outage plus the road to the next delivery; a weak grid changes fuel, not the Tier objective.
